origin_equivalence.relation_id: hash of members, source revisions, relation and supporting locators
origin_equivalence.members: source policy ID + native document ID + immutable content revision
origin_equivalence.proofs: exact source revision/span or structured native-link field; provenance and retrieval clock required
origin_equivalence.native_release_id: wire ID or issuer release ID, never title similarity
origin_equivalence.reporting_party: party responsible for the assertion, distinct from host/publisher
origin_equivalence.valid_from: observed interval with actual source precision
origin_equivalence.independent_origin_count: computed only after proof review; transitive copy chains do not add independent observations

scoped_amount.amount_id: hash of fully scoped amount and immutable support
scoped_amount.currency: exact ISO currency atom; bare dollar unknown
scoped_amount.role: ceiling | option | obligation | financing_authority | gross_proceeds | net_proceeds | other
scoped_amount.period: supported start/end or duration with distinct precision; null is unknown
scoped_amount.support: separate exact revision-bound proof for every scalar/qualifier

correction_lifecycle.required_binding: source-native ID + old/new evidence revisions + affected event revisions + policy/identity versions
correction_lifecycle.runtime_implemented: Only observed index metadata differences and immutable receipts in this patch; other lifecycle states are proposals.
